english:
Scoring 2 Kinetic Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power granting 2.5%|3.75%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 mods equipped.

1 second cooldown after spawning an Orb of Power before additional kills count.

source.text:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.
